Is there a taxonomy database for get_tax()?

Source: R/get_tax.R
has_taxonomy_db.Rd

Checks, without downloading or building anything, whether get_tax() has its taxonomy database: the one it would use with the same taxonomy_db, or, for the results of a search in db_path, the one of the date of those BLAST databases in the BLASTr cache. Useful to stop at the start of a long analysis instead of after the BLAST search, as has_blast() does for BLAST+.

The database counts when it is an SQLite file with the tables nodes and names. When there is none, download_blast_db() brings it with the BLAST database, and get_tax(..., download = TRUE) builds it from the NCBI taxdump.

Usage

has_taxonomy_db(taxonomy_db = NULL, db_path = NULL)

Arguments

taxonomy_db

Path to the SQLite taxonomy database, as in get_tax(). NULL (or NA or "") uses the option BLASTr.taxonomy_db or the environment variable BLASTR_TAXONOMY_DB; with none set, a database in the BLASTr cache.

db_path

Path(s) of the BLAST database(s) to be searched, as in parallel_blast(): the database in the cache is then the one of their date, the one get_tax() uses for the results of that search. NULL: the newest database in the cache, the one get_tax() uses for taxids alone. Ignored when a taxonomy_db is set.

Value

TRUE or FALSE, with the path of the database looked for in the attribute "path".

See also

Other taxonomy functions: get_tax(), get_tax_online, make_taxonomy_db()

Examples

has_taxonomy_db()
#> [1] FALSE
#> attr(,"path")
#> [1] "/home/runner/.cache/R/BLASTr/taxonomy/taxonomy_2026-11-24.sqlite"

# a database that does not exist: FALSE, and nothing is created
x <- has_taxonomy_db(file.path(tempdir(), "taxonomy.sqlite"))
x
#> [1] FALSE
#> attr(,"path")
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpQHmQ5B/taxonomy.sqlite"
attr(x, "path")
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpQHmQ5B/taxonomy.sqlite"
